final_assessment: All 6 findings from codex iter 4 resolved (3 substantive net-new + 3 stale-form-but-spirit-valuable improvements). Change is ready for /opsx:apply.
lesson_captured: User flagged (correctly) that I should not have left known residue for iter 4 to catch. The cleanup-before-review I did in response was the right move BUT it landed too late — codex had already started analysis against the pre-cleanup state. Result: codex's findings were a mix of 'real' and 'stale-form-of-real'. Lesson for next time: do the known-residue cleanup BEFORE pushing the prompt file that kicks off the review. Iter 4 still surfaced 2 fully net-new findings (the overall count error + the repo-layout corruption I introduced via sed), so the review still had value — but the friction of needing pushback on half the findings was avoidable.
